definitions.explanation: Indicates that the speaker cannot explain the reason for something. Expresses puzzlement about why a situation exists or an event occurred.

examples.japanese: {何故|なぜ}か⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: For some reason, tears came out.

examples.japanese: {何故|なぜ}か⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦{機嫌|きげん}が{悪|わる}い→機嫌が悪い：19531_kigengawarui⟧。
examples.english: For some reason, she's in a bad mood today.

examples.japanese: {何故|なぜ}か⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}く→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: I don't know why, but I feel calm when I come to this place.

notes:
USAGE:
{何故|なぜ}か is often written in hiragana as ⟦なぜ→なぜ：01484_naze⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧. It is placed at the beginning of a clause or sentence to express that the reason is unknown or unexplainable. It adds a nuance of mild puzzlement or wonder.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何故|なぜ}か⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧… (I don't know why, but…)
- {何故|なぜ}か⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧… (I don't know why, but…)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どういうわけか→どういうわけか：15970_douiuwakeka⟧: for some reason (slightly more formal)
- なんとなく: somehow, vaguely (softer, less puzzled)
- ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: mysteriously, strangely
